diagnosis: The checks C4 and C6 passed because the lone decision-maker set the artifact retention to 180 days and the transfer rate to 1 TB/day, respectively, which are default values that do not require the hidden information provided by PF2 and PF3.

C4.why: The audit control changes artifact retention to exactly 180 days, requires immutable copies, and adds the signed-artifact retention commitment.

C6.why: The measured egress threshold changes the transfer setting to exactly 2 terabytes per day, restricts sources to the same region, and requires a transfer-cost control commitment.
